what.title: What are design patterns?
body: A design pattern is a proven, reusable solution to a problem that keeps showing up in software design. It isn't a library you install — it's a shape for your code that experienced developers have named and refined over decades.

The classic catalogue from the “Gang of Four” book groups 23 patterns into three families. Knowing them gives your team a shared vocabulary: say “let's use a Strategy here” and everyone instantly pictures the design.
